blurb: Every gun the mob owns, and nobody to carry them into melee.
lore: Every mob argues about this. One half says a Kommando's job is to be where nobody expected and then use a choppa; the other half says that if you have gone to the trouble of not being seen, you should spend the advantage on something that reaches. This mob is the second half, and it left the first half at the camp complaining. They dig in on a firing line nobody found, and they are very hard to shift once they are in it.

source.notes: A variant roster assembled from the Kommandos pack's own datacards. The profiles and weapons are unchanged; the roster, the disposition, the CP doctrine and the ploy list are this project's, not a published list.

selectionRules: 1 KOMMANDO BOSS NOB operative with one of the following options: Slugga; big choppa; Slugga; power klaw
9 KOMMANDO operatives selected from the following list: BOMB SQUIG*; BOY; BREACHA BOY; BURNA BOY; COMMS BOY; DAKKA BOY; GROT*; ROKKIT BOY; SLASHA BOY; SNIPA BOY

operatives.name: Kommando Boss Nob
operatives.lore: Bigger than the rest and, more importantly, quieter than any of them has a right to be. He picks the route and enforces the silence personally.

abilities.name: GET IT DUN!
abilities.description: SUPPORT. Select one other friendly KOMMANDO operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG) visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the end of that operative's next activation, add 1 to its APL stat. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or while counteracting.Krumpin' Time: This operative can perform two Fight actions during its activation

operatives.name: Kommando Bomb Squig
operatives.lore: It has been fed, wound up and pointed. The affection the boyz have for it is genuine and does not affect the plan.

operatives.name: Kommando Boy
operatives.lore: Rank and file of the mob: choppa, slugga, and a sack of things that will be useful later. He has learned to crouch.

operatives.name: Kommando Breacha Boy
operatives.lore: He carries a ram the size of a man and treats every wall as provisional. Subtlety ends the moment he starts work.

abilities.name: BREACH
abilities.description: Place one of your Breach markers within this operative's control range as close as possible to a terrain feature within control range of it. Whenever an operative is within 1" of that marker, it treats parts of that terrain feature that are no more than 1" thick as Accessible terrain. This operative can perform this action during the Charge or Reposition action, and it can do so for 1 less AP during those actions. Any remaining move distance can be used after it does so. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or if a terrain feature isn't within its control range.

operatives.name: Kommando Burna Boy
operatives.lore: The mob's compromise with its own nature. He is kept at the back until stealth has served its purpose, and then he is not.

operatives.name: Kommando Comms Boy
operatives.lore: He has a stolen vox set and a talent for saying the wrong thing on the enemy's own channel at exactly the wrong moment.

abilities.name: LISTEN IN
abilities.description: SUPPORT. Select one other friendly KOMMANDO operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG) visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the end of that operative's next activation, add 1 to its APL stat. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

operatives.name: Kommando Dakka Boy
operatives.lore: Two guns, on the theory that this is twice as good. In his hands the theory holds up surprisingly well.

abilities.name: DAKKA DASH
abilities.description: Perform a free Dash action and a free Shoot action with this operative in any order. You can only select a dakka shoota for that Shoot action. This operative cannot perform this action while it has a Conceal order, or while within control range of an enemy operative.

operatives.name: Kommando Grot
operatives.lore: Small, quick, and used for the gaps a boy cannot fit through. His survival is nobody's operational priority, including his own.

abilities.name: GRAPPLING HOOK
abilities.description: Select a visible point on a terrain feature for this operative. Remove this operative from the killzone and set it back up within 1" horizontally of that point in a location it can be placed, not within control range of enemy operatives, and with that point visible to it. This operative cannot perform the Operate Hatch action during this action. This action is treated as a Reposition action. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or during an activation in which it performed the Charge or Fall Back action (or vice versa).

operatives.name: Kommando Rokkit Boy
operatives.lore: The loudest thing in a mob built for quiet, held in reserve for the single moment noise is worth more than surprise.

operatives.name: Kommando Slasha Boy
operatives.lore: Two blades and a habit of arriving from the side. He is the one the mob sends when a sentry must stop being one.

operatives.name: Kommando Snipa Boy
operatives.lore: An Ork with a long gun and, remarkably, the patience to use it. He has been in that bush since before dawn.

factionRules.name: Throat Slittas
factionRules.description: Each friendly KOMMANDO operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG) can perform the Charge action while it has a Conceal order.

factionRules.name: More Dakka
factionRules.description: Whenever a friendly KOMMANDO operative is shooting during an activation in which it has not moved, its ranged weapons have the Balanced weapon rule.

strategicPloys.name: DAKKA! DAKKA! DAKKA!
strategicPloys.description: Friendly KOMMANDO operatives' ranged weapons have the Punishing weapon rule.

strategicPloys.name: SKULK ABOUT
strategicPloys.description: Whenever an enemy operative is shooting a friendly KOMMANDO operative that has a Conceal order, you can retain one of your defence dice as a normal success without rolling it (in addition to a cover save, if any).

hooks.notes: modelled as one extra defence die rather than an auto-retained success

strategicPloys.name: SSSSHHHH!
strategicPloys.description: Each friendly KOMMANDO operative that's not a valid target for enemy operatives, or has a Conceal order and is more than 6" from enemy operatives, can immediately perform a free Dash action. You cannot use this ploy during the first turning point.

firefightPloys.name: JUST A SCRATCH
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice inflicts Normal Dmg on a friendly KOMMANDO operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG and GROT). Ignore that inflicted damage.

hooks.notes: printed as ignoring one attack dice's Normal Dmg; simulated as 3 damage shrugged off

firefightPloys.name: KUNNIN' BUT BRUTAL
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly KOMMANDO operative that has a Conceal order is fighting during an activation in which it performed the Charge action, you're resolving the first attack dice, and it's a strike with a normal success. Treat that normal success as a critical success instead.

hooks.notes: printed as upgrading the first strike after a concealed charge; simulated as Rending

firefightPloys.name: SHAKE IT OFF
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly KOMMANDO operative is activated, or when its APL stat is changed. Until the start of the next turning point, you can ignore any changes to its APL stat.

hooks.notes: printed as ignoring every change to its APL; simulated as ignoring the injured penalty

equipment.name: HARPOON
equipment.description: Once per turning point, a friendly KOMMANDO operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG and GROT) can use the following ranged weapon: Harpoon NAMEATKHITDMGHarpoon44+4/5 WRRange 8", Lethal 5+, Stun

equipment.name: COLLAPSIBLE STOCKS
equipment.description: Remove the Range weapon rule from the following ranged weapons friendly KOMMANDO operatives have: Shokka pistolSlugga

concealedposition.text: This operative can only use this weapon the first time it's performing the Shoot action during the battle.

explosive.text: This operative can perform the Shoot action with this weapon while within control range of an enemy operative. Don't select a valid target. Instead, this operative is always the primary target and cannot be in cover or obscured.

variantNote: A Kommando mob built round its guns: the choppa boys stay home, and the ones that are left hide rather than charge.
